title: Microsoft Purview: per-policy coverage report for auto-labeling (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
notes: claim 71: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the licensing paragraph carries client-side auto-labeling entitlements over to service-side policies, despite Microsoft's explicit warning against doing so. The report's navigation, documented preview behaviour and government-cloud roadmap facts are supported.
